d:
Passengers travelling from Bihar to Delhi and Sonipat were left stranded at Noida’s Chilla border after a BS-IV overnight bus was stopped amid restrictions on non-BS-VI vehicles entering Delhi.
The bus, carrying around 40–45 passengers, was reportedly fined, forcing travellers to scramble for alternative transport and pay extra to reach their destinations. Passengers expressed frustration over the disruption, while commuters also raised concerns about the need for practical alternatives to tackle pollution.
Indian Express’s Drishti Jain reports from the ground.
